title: Affidavit
description: The sworn evidence record for one proposed write. Every write an agent proposes — create, update or delete — is wrapped in one of these, carrying per-field provenance, before any person sees it and before anything is committed.

operationType.description: The operation being proposed, named by the host's own operation vocabulary (e.g. "WriteUpdate"). An open string, not a closed set, in this seed.

entityType.description: The kind of domain entity being written, named by the host.

entityId.description: The identifier of the entity being written; null for a create operation, where no identifier exists yet.

fields.description: The sworn fields. Not nullable — an empty array, never null.

aggregateConfidence.description: Confidence across the whole affidavit, 0.0 to 1.0. Single-precision float in the .NET wire; not nullable.

warnings.description: Human-readable warnings a reviewer should see. Not nullable — an empty array, never null.

requiresConfirmation.description: Whether a person must confirm this write before it commits.
